areas.title: Sunday Slides
areas.blurb: Prepare and run the screens in Presenter.
areas.help_note: Prepare the song words and run the screens during the gathering.

sections.title: Your role on slides
sections.intro: Slides help the whole room worship together. When the words appear at the right moment, nobody has to think about them, and that is the goal.

items.title: Know the songs
items.text: Being familiar with the songs is half the job. You will know when the next line is coming, and when the band repeats a chorus or jumps to the bridge.

items.title: Prepare at home if you can
items.text: Log in to Presenter at home with your own login and have the slides formatted before Sunday. Sunday morning is then just checking, not building.

items.title: Arrive at 9:00
items.text: Set up the laptop and screen, then run the slides along with the band's practice. It is the best rehearsal you can get for the flow of the morning.

items.title: Check the flow with the worship leader
items.text: Confirm the song order on screen matches what the band is playing, and ask about any repeats, spontaneous moments or changes.

sections.title: Preparing the service
sections.intro: This is done in Presenter. Every week the service should end up in this order:

steps.h: Click Services, then click this Sunday's date
steps.p: Use the Whole Church Gathering for that date. The service's items appear in the list on the left.

steps.h: Click a song, then Edit → Edit song slides
steps.p: The Edit button is at the top right of the song.

steps.h: Song Template must say Collective Template
steps.p: If it is empty (common with new songs), choose Collective Template there, then Save and close.

steps.h: Correct looks like this: CAPITALS on a dark strip
steps.p: Every line is in capital letters with a see-through dark band behind it. Check every song this way.

groups.title: Give each song a background
groups.tip: Colour flow. Give every song a different background from the numbered set (01 Graphite to 12 Warm Pewter) and let the colours move gently from song to song. Example: Warm Pewter → Muted Ochre → Burnt Terracotta → Muted Oxblood → Smoke Aubergine. A reprise can repeat its first colour.

steps.h: Click the song, then Edit → Edit service item
steps.p: Same Edit button as before, first option this time.

steps.h: Set Source to Media from your library, then click Select
steps.p: If Source says None, change it first.

steps.h: Pick a numbered colour and click Select
steps.p: Tip: type the colour name (for example 'ochre') in the search box to find it quickly.

groups.title: Add the weekly slides
groups.tip: Where does a new item go? Presenter adds a new item straight after the item you have selected. So click the item you want it to follow first. If something lands in the wrong place, drag it up or down in the list on the left.

steps.h: Click the item it should follow, then click +
steps.p: For Welcome, start with an empty service, or drag it to the top afterwards. Then choose Media as the type.

steps.h: Search for the slide, click Select, then Save and close
steps.p: Welcome has a DARK and a LIGHT version. Use whichever you prefer. Repeat for New to The Collective, Upcoming events, Home Church, Giving and The Collective Kids.

steps.h: Select the last song, click +, choose Slides, then Select
steps.p: Save the preacher's file to the laptop first (for example in Downloads).
Choose the file and click Open. It appears at the top of the list.
Then set Background Source to None (so the preacher's own design shows) and click Save and close.

steps.h: The list on the left should match the running order
steps.p: A finished example. Click through each item once. Never click anything in the Main Audience Output panel (bottom left) unless you mean to put it on the big screen.

sections.title: Connecting the laptop to the TV

steps.h: Plug the HDMI cable into the laptop

steps.p: The laptop's picture should now show on the TV.

items.s: Templates checked, backgrounds added, weekly slides in order.
HDMI cable into the laptop, then HDMI 1 on the TV. See Part 3.

items.t: Run the slides with the band's practice
Song order and flow checked with the worship leader
Preacher's PowerPoint added at the end, if any

sections.title: Welcoming
sections.intro: Once the areas are ready, your main job is people.

items.title: Look out for new faces
items.text: Introduce yourself, learn their name, and introduce them to someone else.

items.title: Help people find their way
items.text: Show families where kids church is, and point out the tea and coffee and the bathrooms.

items.title: Help people into the gathering
items.text: As things start, gently invite people through and help latecomers find a seat.
